## Objectives

1. Look at the lowest quay steps in [Goa Harbour](../maps/goa_harbour.md)
2. Defeat 40 [Shore Crab](../monsters/shore_crab.md) in [The Undercliff](../maps/undercliff.md)
3. Defeat 40 [Sea Newt](../monsters/sea_newt.md) in [The Undercliff](../maps/undercliff.md)
4. Bring 1 [Shed Newt Claw](../items/shed_newt_claw.md) (taken)

## Rewards

- 16,000 EXP
- 1,600 mesos
- [Dougal's Measure](../items/dougals_measure.md) x1
- +30 standing with Goa Harbour
- +150 standing with [Dougal](../npcs/dougal_quaywatch.md)
